resources.string: The permanent notice shown while a run is open. Dismissing it stops the bus appearing on the school\'s map.
Raised when the phone cannot report — location switched off, permission revoked, or the run closed by the office.
The six-digit PIN from the office
My login is an email or a longer password
The six-digit code the office shows you
Sign in with your number instead
I was given a pairing code
You are signed in, but this school has no bus set up yet. Ask the office to add one.
Unpaired. Ask the office for a code for the right bus.
That number and PIN do not match. Check both and try again, or ask the office to check your number.
Too many wrong PINs. Wait fifteen minutes and try again, or ask the office to reset it.
No PIN has been issued for this number yet. Ask the office to issue one.
This login is not a driver\'s. Ask the office to put you on a bus, then sign in again.
Too many attempts from this phone. Wait a few minutes and try again.
No bus is assigned to you yet. Ask the office to put you on a bus.
No bus in this school has that code. Check the sticker, or ask the office which bus you are on.
No connection to the school. Check the phone\'s signal and try again.
That code is not valid or has expired. Ask the office for a fresh one.
This app needs updating. Tell the office.
Could not sign in. Try again, or call the office.
Could not pair. Try again, or call the office.
This bus already has a run open. Close it, or take it over.
The school can see this bus
The school cannot see this bus
%1$d positions are saved on this phone and will be sent when there is signal. Nothing is lost.
Sign in to start a run
The school records who drove each run.
Bus: the one this phone is paired to
It goes off this phone\'s list. The office can put it back.
No route is on this bus yet. Ask the office to add one, then sign in again.
End run tells the school the children are off the bus.
The school will be told the children are off the bus and this phone stops reporting.
Take the bus back to school
No maps app on this phone
Nobody is on this route yet, or the school has not answered. Tracking still runs.
%1$d marks waiting for signal. Nothing is lost.
Absent. Tap On if they come.
Mark each child as they get on.
Mark each child as they get off.
Location, battery and notifications are set up.
Battery saving thins out the tracking
The phone slows this app down once the screen has been off a while, and the bus jumps across the map instead of moving.
This app tells you through a notification when the school closes a run or the phone stops reporting. With them off you will not be told.
The run stays open and the school sees the bus stop moving. Only do this once the bus is parked.
Nothing is running now. This only shuts down what is left of the tracker.
Tracking is stopped. The school cannot see this bus until it is on again.
The run stays open, but this phone stops sending its position. The school\'s map will show the bus where it last was.
This phone stops sending its position.
Sign in as a different driver
Takes this phone off the bus and asks for a number and PIN again. Nothing is reported in the meantime.
Take this phone off the bus?
The phone forgets which bus it is and stops reporting. You will sign in again with your number and PIN.
This phone has stopped reporting. If you are still on the route, start the run again.
The school\'s server says the time is %1$s. Nothing can be recorded until the phone\'s date and time are corrected.
This phone has been signed out
The office took this phone off the bus, or you signed in on another handset. It has stopped reporting. Sign in again with your number and PIN to carry on.
Runs you start will be recorded against your name until you sign out.
Ask the office for a pairing code before signing in.
This route has no stops set up
The bus will still show on the map, but the school cannot be told which stop it has reached. Mention it to the office.
This bus already has a run open
%1$s\n\nTaking it over closes the other run. Do that only if you are sure the other phone is finished.
Sign in before starting the run
The school records who drove each run, so the phone needs your number and PIN before it can open one.
The school\'s server refused: %1$s. Try again; if it keeps failing, call the office.
This phone is no longer paired
Ask the office for a new pairing code.
Run ended, but the school was not told yet
There was no signal. This phone will tell the school as soon as it has one. Leave the app installed and the phone switched on.
There was no signal. This phone will tell the school as soon as it has one, and send the %1$d positions from the end of the route with it. Leave the app installed and the phone switched on.
Off the route, finding a new one
Stops to scale, about %1$s across. No roads are drawn.
The school\'s map, and the message a parent gets when the bus is near their stop, come from this phone\'s position.
Nothing is recorded before Start run or after End run. Where you go in the evening is not collected.
An approximate position cannot tell a parent the bus has reached their stop. Please allow precise location.
One more setting: "Allow all the time"
Android stops giving this app your position when the screen goes off unless you choose "Allow all the time". Without it the bus vanishes from the map every time you put the phone down.
Android opens its own settings page for this app. Choose Location, then "Allow all the time".
